title: Sunapee Cruises

services.name: Dinner Cruise
services.desc: The nightly dinner cruise lasts 2 hours and is narrated by one of our Captains, all of whom are extremely knowledgeable about the history and lore of Lake Sunapee and surrounding area. The M.V. Sunapee Lake Queen features two decks of enclosed dining and an open-air walkway around the top deck. Take your pick of location to sip on a refreshing cocktail as you cruise out of Sunapee Harbor, taking in the beautiful New Hampshire scenery. As you dine on a delicious buffet dinner, you will learn about the sites and history of the lake. If nature cooperates, you may even see one of our phenomenal sunsets. services.name: Brunch Charter
services.desc: Sunapee Cruises and our caterer, Appleseed Catering, will provide the dinner for your private cruise. The Dinner Charter includes all the features of a Bareboat Charter PLUS: appetizer, salad bar, dinner, dessert and coffee. Your group may want to arrive early to enjoy Sunapee Harbor before your cruise. The picturesque Harbor is a great place to stroll or just sit and relax. There are unique shops, an art gallery, eateries, historical museum, and Saturday afternoon entertainment. The cruise provides for great photo opportunities with amazing sunsets, lighthouses and mountain views so have your cameras ready.
